Detail Records

Search affects only this table (and CSV export), not the KPIs or charts. Slicers and chart clicks affect everything.

Metric definitions
  • Recognised Revenue: sum of Recognised Revenue INR (0 for non-recognised orders).
  • Contribution Profit: sum of Contribution Profit INR. Profit Margin = total profit ÷ total revenue.
  • Total Orders: distinct Order IDs (multi-line orders count once). Unique Customers: distinct Customer IDs.
  • Units Sold: Quantity of Delivered lines only. AOV = revenue ÷ distinct Delivered orders.
  • Order Return Rate = distinct Returned orders ÷ distinct (Delivered + Returned) orders.
